recommendation: HOLD_MAINLINE_ACCEPTANCE; merge original commits only into a ROOT-owned isolation tree for systemic harness repair, preserve worker and original FAIL evidence. No production src fix is currently justified.

findings.root_cause: Cleanup classifies generated content by top-level name, not creation ownership. The baseline snapshot only detects loss after recursive deletion; raw_unchanged is returned True regardless. Existing generated-name subtrees and nested output roots are not protected.
findings.observed: 3 preexisting synthetic scratch/logs/cfg sentinels were actually deleted by cleanup_owned_root; restored returned false, raw_unchanged returned true. Exact test baseline was rescued then the newly owned root restored absent.
findings.repair: Use a fresh per-attempt generated workspace under an explicit owned root, keep baseline and out-root separate, validate root overlap/symlink/collisions before creating or deleting, and delete only files/directories recorded as created by this attempt. Preserve existing sentinels and empty directories; never delete by name alone.

findings.root_cause: S1 overwrites actual CLI manifests with in-process reader facts. S2 consumer exit/status is not mandatory to determine its PASS; therefore local reader success can hide an independent consumer/export failure.
findings.observed: Static real diff shows export[manifests] is replaced after export_via_cli; oracle mutants also demonstrate missing/incorrect downstream evidence accepted. This is a tool evidence defect, not proof of a real current CLI failure.
findings.repair: Retain immutable actual child JSON/exit/stdout/stderr and source manifests; perform comparisons against fixed fixture facts without synthesizing replacements. Require successful fresh child reopen and exact source-ref identity; failed/absent child evidence produces PARTIAL/FAIL.

findings.root_cause: Nonempty scenarios/read lists substitute for the required seven-scene/document coverage. verify_version is treated as a returned-byte read. Several new-version/root/path checks are omitted; period expectations can be rewritten inside the report. Nested weak types can raise instead of returning a diagnostic.
findings.observed: Seven independent mutated reports still PASS; malformed S2 actual=[] causes AttributeError. Original worker report still evaluates PASS. Mutant details are preserved in probes.json.
findings.repair: Validate typed nested shapes before business checks, exact S1-S7 coverage and required original coverage, actual open_version byte checks, before/after root equality from observed config, S5 new-version and recovery reads, S7 no path fields, and fixed fixture expected FY/period/kind with UNKNOWN/PARTIAL rather than invented dates. Invalid input returns structured INVALID; no whole-run crash.

findings.root_cause: The consumer re-queries identity/SHA then opens a refreshed ref, ignoring the full SourceRef received from upstream (schema/size/MIME). It does not replay the exact input ref.
findings.observed: Against canonical ae0ca0d3 reader, direct wrong byte_size ref is rejected as source_ref_changed. Worker consumer_spy accepts that same wrong input (input 256 bytes / actual 255), exits 0 and reports status ok after query_ref refresh. Reader package prefix alone was adjusted to its true canonical import location; bytes and SourceReader were not mocked.
findings.repair: Deserialize and open the exact received SourceRef. Any query is diagnostic only; never replace the supplied ref. Include wrong size/MIME/schema ref negatives and exact valid fresh-child replay.

findings.root_cause: Harness child env copies the whole user environment. The runner is synthetic/offline and does not need credentials, real HOME or arbitrary inherited PYTHONPATH.
findings.observed: Static code inherits os.environ.copy; no provider/key usage was observed or triggered. Independent helper strips env, uses synthetic HOME, blocks credential-file reads/network, and pins canonical module binding.
findings.repair: Use a small runtime env allowlist, synthetic HOME/profile, explicit pinned PYTHONPATH and config, no provider keys. Declare synthetic-only scope and retain failure outputs per attempt.
